questions.question_text: Given that $(-14)^{6}=7\,529\,536$, what is the value of $14^{6}$?

options.why: Assumed removing the negative sign from the base must flip the sign of the answer.
Multiplied the base by the index instead of using the given value.

questions.solution_text:
$14^{6}$
The index $6$ is even, so the six negative signs in $(-14)^{6}$ pair up and the two powers are equal.
$=7\,529\,536$
